title: Ryan Cohen disclosed another 700,000-share purchase
mechanism: A repeated primary-source CEO open-market purchase adds incremental demand and strengthens the corporate catalyst, but does not itself establish a squeeze.
stateEffect: Strengthens the corporate catalyst while the deterministic squeeze state falls to DORMANT because the purchase is outside the three-day current-catalyst gate at the October 6 observation and other mechanisms are stale or unavailable.
observations: Cohen purchased an aggregate 700,000 shares on October 2, 2026 at a weighted average price of $24.4061 in open-market transactions.
The filing reports 41,648,522 shares directly owned after the purchase.
Including 3,734,784 warrant shares, Cohen reported beneficial ownership of 45,383,306 shares, approximately 8.9%.
